captures.observed: La captura muestra Request URL https://inmonode-backend.onrender.com/api/v1/field-sync/portfolio y Server response 401. El body contiene code=UNAUTHORIZED y message=Authentication is required or the token is invalid or expired. La petición visible no incluye Authorization ni If-None-Match.
